entities.name: Esika
entities.description: The green-aligned god of the World Tree on Kaldheim, who makes the Cosmos Elixir that sustains the other gods.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The tree Esika understands and whose sap makes the Cosmos Elixir.

entities.name: Cosmos Elixir
entities.description: An elixir made from the sap of the World Tree that gives the gods immortality, power and divinity.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God who used runic magic to commune with the World Tree.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: Phyrexian invader who mauled Esika and took a tyrite sample.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Used by Vorinclex as a distraction.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion Tree
entities.description: Corrupted tree grown from the stolen essence that forced its way into the Cosmos on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: Leader of the Omenseeker clan whose vision charts safe routes for Esika's chariot.

events.summary: Esika and Tergrid come into being when Alrund uses runic magic to commune with the World Tree.
events.quote: Esika and her sister Tergrid came into being when Alrund used runic magic to commune with the World Tree .

events.summary: Vorinclex finds Esika's sanctum and mauls her; dying, she revives herself with the Cosmos Elixir.
events.quote: On the brink of death, she revived herself using the Cosmos Elixir.

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion Tree forces its way into the Cosmos and disorients Esika.
events.quote: Esika became disoriented, losing her connection to the Cosmos and her ability to guide herself through its vast expanse.

events.summary: Esika turns to Inga Rune-Eyes, who charts safe routes for her chariot.
events.quote: Inga charts the safest routes for Esika's chariot
